medicines.name: Duloxetine
medicines.summary: Used for certain types of nerve pain and selected depression and anxiety disorders.

whatShouldIKnowBeforeTakingIt: Tell a healthcare professional about liver disease, kidney problems, high blood pressure, bipolar disorder, pregnancy or breastfeeding.
Other antidepressants and certain medicines can interact.
Dizziness may affect alertness.

medicines.name: Carbamazepine
medicines.summary: Used for certain seizure disorders and trigeminal neuralgia, which causes episodes of severe facial pain.

medicines.name: Metformin
medicines.summary: Commonly used for type 2 diabetes, alone or with other diabetes medicines.

Long-term use can be associated with vitamin B12 deficiency, which may contribute to anaemia or nerve symptoms.
